COLLECT_FORK.md.rationale: Retain local fork provenance, bounded changes and explicit behavior/provider/license evidence limitations; this document grants no release approval.

UPSTREAM-SHA256.json.rationale: Retain exact per-file hashes of the original cached upstream package; this verifier independently requires equality with every file in the authenticated official archive.

lib/src/collect_browser_invalidation.dar.rationale: Add a bounded versioned 30-second project-bound departed actor/session invalidation protocol with exact key/type/UUID checks. JWT decoding derives non-authorizing owner references only; matching cannot authenticate, refresh or grant authority.

test/synthetic_jwt.dart.rationale: Construct claim/expiry fixtures with a plainly invalid synthetic signature instead of copied signed credentials. This helper belongs to retained upstream test fixtures, not runtime authentication.

analysis_options.yaml.rationale: Use the app-locked flutter_lints; exclude the retained upstream example/test cohorts whose separate dev toolchain is absent from the app lock. Runtime remains analyzed; this verification does not claim those upstream tests executed.

lib/src/broadcast_web.dart.rationale: Bound untrusted browser channel payload shape, nesting and size; discard malformed inputs without logging credential payloads. Remove full-message logging while retaining event logging.

lib/src/gotrue_client.dart.rationale: Browser-only channel traffic may invalidate the exact departed project/actor/session and never adopt credentials or authenticate another tab. Capture the departed session before asynchronous logout cleanup to protect replacement sessions; preserve native branches, existing Auth events and broadcast markers. Remove browser credential/session logging. One ReplaySubject layout-only formatting change is also included.

pubspec.yaml.rationale: Remove only the workspace-resolution declaration to permit the local override; preserve package name/version and dependency versions.

test/client_test.dart.rationale: Replace copied signed session/token strings in parser and recovery fixtures with explicit synthetic opaque values or existing local session fixture generation. Preserve assertions and other upstream test bodies; remaining diff is Dart formatting. These retained upstream integration tests are not claimed as executed.

test/get_claims_test.dart.rationale: Replace copied signed/example JWT strings with synthetic structurally parseable, cryptographically invalid signatures; preserve the expiry/claim assertions and integration tests. Remaining diff is Dart formatting; no signed-session fixture is introduced.

review_scope: Exact-byte origin and engineering-purpose review of the existing retained fork; not behavior/device/provider/advisory/distribution-rights/release approval.
